# Project Kickoff Agenda — Feb 3, 2026, 10:00 AM ET
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

A 45-minute kickoff designed to align scope, ownership, risks, and cadence for a 7-person team: 1 PM, 2 designers, 3 engineers, and 1 stakeholder.

## 45-Minute Meeting Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg

- 10:00–10:05 — Welcome and objectives
  - Confirm meeting goals and desired outcomes
  - Quick attendee introductions and role context

- 10:05–10:15 — Scope and success criteria
  - Review project purpose, in-scope items, and exclusions
  - Agree on what “done” looks like

- 10:15–10:25 — Solution direction and design needs
  - Designers share early approach and key UX/UI questions
  - Engineers flag technical constraints and dependencies

- 10:25–10:35 — Ownership and milestones
  - Assign owners for design, engineering, coordination, and stakeholder review
  - Confirm first milestone and handoff points

- 10:35–10:42 — Risks, blockers, and decisions needed
  - Identify top risks, unknowns, and open questions
  - Decide what needs follow-up before work starts

- 10:42–10:45 — Weekly check-ins and close
  - Confirm recurring meeting time and format
  - Recap actions, owners, and next steps

## Decisions to Make
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/check2-square.svg

- Final scope boundaries: what is included and excluded
- Primary owner for each workstream
- Review cadence: weekly check-in day/time and attendees
- First milestone date and definition of completion
- Risk escalation path for blockers or scope changes
- Stakeholder review points and approval expectations

## Follow-Up Email Template
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/envelope.svg

Subject: Project Kickoff Recap and Next Steps

Hi team,

Thanks for joining the kickoff today. We aligned on the project scope, discussed initial design and engineering considerations, identified key risks, and agreed to hold weekly check-ins.

Next steps:
- Finalize owners for each workstream
- Document scope and success criteria
- Capture risks and open questions
- Confirm the weekly check-in schedule
- Share the first milestone plan

Please reply with any corrections or additions by end of day.

Best,
[Your Name]
